text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product image, pure white background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, no person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire object fully visible. Chocolate brown fitted jacket with attached tan faux-fur collar and cuffs, dark brown short shorts, sheer brown tights shown hollow, tan tall lace-up shearling-lined flat boots.
original_prompt: Edit this hollow wardrobe product photo: remove all flesh-colored legs, knees and anatomical body surface from inside the tights. Keep ONLY empty translucent gray-black hosiery fabric with the white background showing through it; preserve any fabric pattern. Keep all garments, shoes, materials and cuts otherwise unchanged. Pure white backdrop, fully uncropped portrait 2:3. No body, skin, mannequin or new objects.
reproduction_note: 根据服装参考生成无人商品展示。遮挡或未展示的细节采用保守补全；文字和品牌细节仅为视觉参考。未进行逐图重新生成相似度验证。
